name: pudl-tests
description: Browser tests for PUDL and the maintainer's minifier. A project using PUDL builds nothing and depends on nothing; this file exists only for the tests and build/minify.js.

scripts.test:static: node tests/tokens.check.js && node build/palette-themes.js --check && node --test build/skin-definition.test.js build/skin-css.test.js build/suite-result.test.js build/palette-themes.test.js build/suite-plan.test.js build/verify-shards.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:static && node tests/run.js chromium
scripts.test:all: npm run test:static && node tests/run.js chromium firefox webkit
